sentences.text: Patrick Pouyanne, born June 24, 1963, is a French engineer who graduated from the Ecole Polytechnique and became a Chief Engineer of France's Corps des Mines; between 1989 and 1996 he held various posts in the Ministry of Industry and ministerial cabinets, including technical advisor for environment and industry to Prime Minister Edouard Balladur and chief of staff to minister Francois Fillon.

sentences.quote: In January 1997, he joined TotalEnergies' Exploration & Production division, first as Chief Administrative Officer in Angola, before becoming Company representative in Qatar
sentences.text: He joined the group's Exploration and Production division in January 1997, serving in Angola and then Qatar, and in January 2012 became President, Refining and Chemicals and a member of the Executive Committee.
He was appointed Chief Executive Officer on October 22, 2014, and Chairman of the Board from December 19, 2015.
